Variants.Content: Maiden Spring is located in the east of the Riverlands and on the west coast of Crab Bay. It is a port town ruled by the Mouton family. It belongs to the inter-river feudal system represented by Riverrun, and is connected to the valley, royal territory and narrow sea trade through sea routes; the town's wealth comes from harbors, fisheries, markets and roads to the interior.

Entry Maidenpool Local families also relied on river transportation, ferries, wheat fields, mills, and hiding places when war came; if any road, well, spring, or dock failed, the price would fall first on them.

Entry Maidenpool They also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of the Riverlands; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hooves.

Entry Maidenpool If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

The craftsmen saw shipbuilding wood, canvas, salt, fish catch, and stones to resist the sea wind in Maidenfountain. The clergy guarded the memory of the Seven Gods, the legend of the ancient river king, and the land that changed hands repeatedly. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Maidenpool They care about river transportation, ferries, wheat fields, mills, and hiding places when war comes. They also care about whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
